title: Proud Father Holding Baby, Patio Umbrella - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical outdoor black-and-white snapshot captures a proud middle-aged father in suspenders, a collared shirt, necktie, and high-waisted pleated trousers holding his young infant up toward the camera. In the background stands a fringed lawn or patio umbrella alongside evergreen pine branches. A handwritten caption across the lower white border reads 'Proud "Papa"'. The reverse features a faint three-digit processing stamp '528'.
